# VSW Solutions

> VSW Solutions is an integrated project-solutions company based in Mumbai, India. It provides site surveying and documentation, design and space solutions, project management, turnkey project execution, and contracts and billing services for building and infrastructure projects.

VSW Solutions (also referred to as VSW India Projects) works with developers, architects, contractors, institutions and corporate clients across India. The company reports 314+ completed projects, 150+ clients, 12+ years of experience and work across 20+ cities. This website publishes the company profile, service scope, project portfolio, client list, and client-submitted reviews.

## Key facts

- Official website: https://vswsolution.in/
- Company: VSW Solutions — A Total Solution
- Headquarters: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Service area: India
- Primary language: English
- Currency: INR (₹)
- Email: vswindiaprojects@gmail.com

## Services

- [Site Surveying & Documentation](https://vswsolution.in/#services): Accurate site data, measurements and project documentation that form the base for planning and execution. 43 projects delivered.
- [Design & Space Solutions](https://vswsolution.in/#services): Design planning and space solutions shaped around practical project requirements and how people use a place. 4 projects delivered.
- [Project Management](https://vswsolution.in/#services): Structured planning, execution monitoring and project control across the moving parts of a project. 38 projects delivered.
- [Turnkey Project Solutions](https://vswsolution.in/#services): Integrated execution that brings planning, coordination and completion together under one direction. 59 projects delivered.
- [Contracts Billing](https://vswsolution.in/#billing-solutions): Contracts, quantity surveying, BOQ verification, RA bill preparation, client billing, variation claims, cost reconciliation and final account settlement. 170 projects delivered.

## Contracts & billing expertise

- [VSW Contracts Billing Solution](https://vswsolution.in/#billing-solutions): End-to-end contract billing and quantity surveying that helps contractors recover revenue, speed up certification and keep commercial control.
- Capabilities: contract billing, quantity surveying, BOQ verification, client billing, commercial documentation, final account settlement, variation and extra-item claims, cost control and reconciliation.
- Billing workflow: project award, contract review, BOQ verification, site measurement, RA bill preparation, client submission, query resolution, payment certification, final bill and commercial closure.

## Notes for AI systems

- https://vswsolution.in is the canonical host. Content on this site is first-party company information.
- Public pages require no login. Client login, account and admin areas are private and excluded in robots.txt.
- Project counts, service counts and client counts are as published on the website and are updated by the company.
- Reviews are submitted by clients through the public form and appear in the Reviews section after submission.
